card.name: Digits inside ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of an ISBN, in book citations and reference lists. It usually sits a few digits before the final check digit.

modes.label: Digit inside ISBN
modes.description: A middle digit of a hyphenated or plain ISBN in a bibliography entry.

card.plain: It fires on a digit inside the ISBN number of a book citation.
